# `ccl` standard library

The `ccl` module implements the [Categorical Configuration Language (CCL)](https://github.com/chshersh/ccl)
parser, data model, deterministic serializer, and package manifest/lockfile validator
used by Edva's package manager.

```dva
#use ccl
```

## Data model

The core document model represents nested, indentation-delimited key-value entries:

```dva
#type Strings (String){}

#type CclVal <
   Str(String),
   Block(CclDoc)
>

#type CclEntry (
   key: String,
   val: CclVal,
   line: Int,
   col: Int
)

#type CclEntries (CclEntry){}

#type CclDoc (
   entries: CclEntries
)
```

## Parsing and serialization

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ccl::parse` | `String, String => < CclDoc \| Error >` | Parse CCL text with an associated source path for diagnostics |
| `ccl::parse_file` | `String => < CclDoc \| Error >` | Read and parse a CCL configuration file from disk |
| `ccl::to_ccl` | `CclDoc => String` | Serialize a `CclDoc` into a canonical, deterministic CCL string |
| `ccl::has` | `CclDoc, String => <>` | Check if a top-level key exists in the document |
| `ccl::get` | `CclDoc, String => < String \| >` | Retrieve the string value of a top-level key |
| `ccl::get_section` | `CclDoc, String => < CclDoc \| >` | Retrieve a nested block section as a sub-document |
| `ccl::get_list` | `CclDoc, String => < Strings \| >` | Retrieve entries sharing the specified key as a list of strings |

```dva
doc = ccl::parse("name = demo\nversion = 0.1.0", "edva.ccl")!!
name = ccl::get(doc, "name") | n => n | "unknown"
```

## Package manifest and lockfile validation

The module provides schema models and validators for `edva.ccl` manifests and `edva.lock.ccl` lockfiles:

- `ccl::validate_manifest`: validates a `CclDoc` against Edva package manifest requirements (`name`, `version`, `edva`, `dependencies`, `native-libs`).
- `ccl::manifest_to_ccl`: serializes a `PackageManifest` record back into deterministic CCL.
- `ccl::validate_lockfile`: validates resolved package lockfile data.
- `ccl::lockfile_to_ccl`: renders a resolved `Lockfile` structure into deterministic lockfile format.
